speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Do the London ladies paint, brother, or is that a story we tell so the country will have something to do?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Some paint. I have not been set to judge a cheek. Pass the bread, Joan, before the question eats the meal.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Three to the inch too few. But they smell like a duchess.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I'll put them on. The inch is thy father's quarrel. The hand is mine. They are warm, which is more than a count is.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: By my troth, wear them. I taught thee to count a stitch, Will. I did not teach thee to buy for a nose. The nose has won, and I am not weeping.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I bought them for the nose, sir. The count I left to the shop, and the shop has had it.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: May I hold the sword after the fish? And say exactly how Master Burbage dies. Not the sermon of it. The death.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou mayest hold it when the spoon is done. He dies like this. The spoon is the sword. Mind the bowl.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The spoon turned. Do it again, slower. The quick one hides the hinge. Edmund can have the dying. I want the wrist.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I do not want the hinge. I want the fall, and one last thing said, and a spoon doing it magnificently, which is a hard brief.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Show the fall slower. If you hide the hinge you are only telling a story, and a story does not turn.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He falls. Then the spoon is a spoon, because supper is still supper. And thou wilt finish school, Edmund. London is not a part thou can borrow with a spoon.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I did not say I would be a chief player. I said I would begin. Finishing school is a beginning that takes a very long time.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Finish the school, and finish the fish. I am not a lane between thee and London, and I am not carrying a death into the kitchen.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Grandfather crosses a room like this, when the gloves have won. The knee first. Then the opinion, a little behind the knee, as if the opinion were lame and proud of it.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: By St George, that is my own knee. I am not rebuking it. A house that cannot be walked by a child is a house with no walk in it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Sit. Pottage, salt fish, new bread. The sword is not the meal. Hamnet, the spoon goes back in the bowl before it becomes thy trade.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It went back. It turns too far if you let it, which is how you know the hinge is honest. Judith did the knee better than the knee.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I did it once. Once is the rule. Twice would be a mock, and a mock at this table gets a person the small piece of fish. I have calculated.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. Nobody is rebuked. Richard is passing the salt and spending no words on it, which is a skill I do not have.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Then do not spend the words on paint. Some paint. That is an answer a kitchen can keep. Mother has the bread. Susanna has her book by the bowl. The stool from the shop is the tenth place.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Susanna is not required to read a riddle between the fish and the salt. Ten, with the stool. The stool is only a stool. Thou art home, Will. Eat.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: After school, then. Not instead of it. I am putting the sword where it can be seen, so I remember the spoon was a death and is a spoon again.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I can see it from here. That will do for supervision. The hilt is still worn. That part is still true.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: God's my comfort. A short stitch, a wooden sword, and the pottage not cold. I have sat at tables with less to count, and I counted them anyway.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: He is pleased. I am not doing the pleased voice. The knee was the whole of the performance, and the performance is spent.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then it is over. The gloves are on. Faith, pass the fish before it becomes another speech.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Paint, a spoon, a knee, and a stitch. I asked one question and I was given a pageant. The bread, brother, is still bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bread is the answer. I am eating it. Finish the school, Edmund. Once was enough to hear it.
